CreateAppEnv.title: Create Deployment Environment
CreateAppEnv.description:
- You can select an existing environment or a configuration template to quickly create a deployment environment. When using either method, the new environment will be deployed with the deployment package version from the selected environment or configuration template.  
- If you do not specify an existing environment or a configuration template, you must provide a technology stack ID and a deployment package version ID.  
- If you specify multiple parameters among the source environment ID, configuration template ID, and technology stack ID simultaneously, the new environment will be created following the priority order: source environment ID, configuration template ID, and then technology stack ID.  
- After this API is invoked, if the change is not a simulation, it returns the change ID for this creation. You can use this ID to query the change details.
